mechanics: Your share = your valid trading volume that day ÷ everyone's valid trading volume × 60% of the day's pool. From 100 USDT a day; volume above 3,000,000 USDT a day counts as 3,000,000.
Your share = your valid assets that day ÷ all participants' valid assets × 40% of the day's pool. From 100 USDT; the day's value is your lowest hourly snapshot, capped at 3,000,000 USDT.

faq: What is the Bitget Alliance Program?

A Bitget.com campaign from 28 Sep to 26 Oct 2026. Bitget puts 30% of its trading-fee revenue into a prize pool and shares it every day among users who trade or hold at least 100 USDT. The pool passed 4.8 million USDT on 11 Oct and keeps growing until the end.
Do I need to register for the campaign?
No. On any day your valid trading volume or your assets reach 100 USDT, you share that day's pool automatically. You only open the campaign page to claim your rewards.
Yes. New users take part the same way: open a Bitget.com account, then trade or hold 100 USDT a day. You share the pool from the first day you qualify.

It depends on your share of the day. With Bitget's figures for 11 Oct, every 10,000 USDT of valid trading volume earned about 0.49 USDT that day and 100,000 USDT about 4.86 USDT; volume counts up to 3,000,000 USDT a day. Holding 10,000 USDT added about 0.10 USDT.
When and how are rewards paid?
Bitget settles every 3 days and pays within 2 working days. Open the campaign page and the claim window appears; claim within 180 days. Each claim also opens a mystery box that always wins.

Futures (USDT-M, Coin-M, USDC-M), spot, trading bots, copy trading and API trades count as volume; everything in your account counts as assets, including Earn, margin and futures. Onchain, CFDs, U.S. Stock+, Convert, stablecoin pairs and zero-fee pairs do not count.
Can I join from my country?
Bitget decides who can join by region. Bitget does not serve some countries, the US among them; if the campaign page says you are not eligible, your account cannot take part.
